issues: All styles classify as Core (20 Core, 0 Fashion, 0 Test) - expected behavior per agent context: sample data has uniform weekly sales

critical_code_review_comments: Store Wedge classification uses cumulative revenue share: A=top 80%, B=next 15%, C=bottom 5%
Style Mix classification: Core=avg>5/wk + >80% presence, Fashion=peak/avg>3x + <26wk, Test=<8wk or <2/wk
Assortment Matrix correctly maps: A=Full (Core+Fashion+Test), B=Standard (Core+Fashion), C=Efficiency (Core only)
All endpoints properly require authentication (return 400 without token)
Frontend has proper data-testid attributes for testing
_tenant_match() helper handles sample data without tenant_id field
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Tests used existing sample data (30 stores, 173 SKUs, 185k daily sales records).
